doc: The values parquet_stream's defaults held until 2026-10-22 (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.78): 1,281,167 samples, ImageNet-1k's training count, of a median 110 KiB, as rows, 1,024 to a shard; batch 256, 4 shards interleaved each 1 ahead, 500 steps of 105 ms, no decode compute. Placeholders, not measured, and untraced: no application run stands behind them.
